transformFromBodyParts3D: p_bonesim = (x, z, -y) / 1000 (BodyParts3D mm, +X left, +Y posterior, +Z superior)
axisConvention: World/rest-pose unit vectors. Rotating the CHILD segment about the joint 'center' by +angle (right-hand rule, i.e. THREE.Quaternion.setFromAxisAngle(axis, +angle)) produces the POSITIVE anatomical motion named by the key (flexion, pronation, dorsiflexion, inversion, abduction, internalRotation, ulnarDeviation, ...). This matches src/shared/conventions.js signs, e.g. elbow flexion axis ≈ -X (= Rx(-flex)), knee flexion axis ≈ +X (= Rx(+flex)), forearm pronation axis ≈ -s·Y (= Ry(-s·pron)), ankle dorsiflexion ≈ -X, hip abduction ≈ +s·Z, s = +1 left / -1 right. Spine/neck joints: flexion +X, lateralBend +Z (toward subject's right), axialRotation +Y (toward left).
restPoseNote: GLB vertices are at the BodyParts3D rest pose (≈ anatomical position, palms forward) in world coordinates; nodes are NOT re-pivoted. Pivot each segment at joints[segment.joint].center.

hip_L.method: robust sphere fit to femoral head (r=23.0 mm, rms=0.63 mm); axes = pelvis frame (conventions hipQ)

knee_L.method: flexion axis through centres of spheres fitted to the posterior femoral condyles (r med 20.2 / lat 18.5 mm); centre = midpoint. axialRotation = tibial mechanical axis (plateau centre→ankle centre), + = internal rotation of tibia (screw-home = external = negative)

patellofemoral_L.method: centre = circle fit (in plane ⟂ knee axis) to the deepest points of the femoral trochlear groove; patella rotates about axes.flexion through this centre (≈0.7×knee flexion) keeping |patellaApex−tibialTuberosity| = patellarTendonLength

talocrural_L.method: axis through tips of medial (tibia) and lateral (fibula) malleoli (Inman); centre = point on that axis closest to the talar dome sphere centre (r=17.9 mm)

subtalar_L.method: Inman average axis: 42° above horizontal, 23° medial to foot long axis (heel→2nd metatarsal head); anchored at centroid of talus–calcaneus articular contact. + = inversion/supination
